$comment: Single source of truth for batch-candidate routing (.ai/docs/batch-branches.md). Read by scripts/ci/batch-candidate.mjs from ci.yml and ci-label-rerun.yml. To route by a dedicated label instead of by author, set candidateLabel to that label name; authors is then ignored. The full-suite paths live in FULL_SUITE_PATTERN in .github/workflows/ci.yml and also exclude a PR.
